Library hours

Hours for the main library and the bookmobile, with this month's holiday closures.

The office will be closed on Friday, November 13, for Veterans Day.

Book drops stay open all weekend. Items due while we are closed are due the next day we are open, and no late fees are charged for those days. Holds placed before the closure wait for you at the front desk until the following Wednesday.

The library is open Monday to Thursday from nine in the morning to eight in the evening, and Saturday from ten to five. Study rooms can be booked up to a week ahead at the front desk or by phone.
